## 3. Population, timing, variables and estimands

Set `b_i=53-0.0`; retain parsed dates `2006-01-01 <= b_i <= 2010-12-31`. A valid primary cancer slot requires a parseable `40005-k.0` date and nonempty normalized ICD-10 `40006-k.0` code in the same slot; never borrow neighboring slots. Report malformed, unpaired, duplicate and discordant slots.

Exclude participants with an observed paired C00–C97 record on/before `b_i` in either `40005/40006` or `41270/41280`. This means no observed pre-assessment cancer record, not true cancer-free status. Select the earliest valid post-`b_i` `40005/40006` C00–C97 record as `t0_i`; CRC is C18/C19/C20 and non-CRC is other C00–C97. Retain `0<L_i=t0_i-b_i<=1825` days and valid reserve/covariates. Set `Y_i=1` for `L_i<730`, 0 for 730–1825 days. Diagnoses after 1825 are descriptive only. Every included person has an observed paired diagnosis; absence of a record is never an outcome.

Define the pre-assessment recordability proxy from paired `41270-0.j`/`41280-0.j`, j=0,...,258. A valid dated pair is a nonempty code with a parseable date in `[1900-01-01,b_i)`. Let `H_i` be the number of unique non-cancer code/date pairs before `b_i` (excluding C00–C97), `H_any_i` its indicator, and `H_cat_i` categories 0, 1, 2–4, >=5. Report `H_all_i` (all paired codes) descriptively. H is a dated diagnosis-record opportunity proxy, not a healthcare-encounter count or completeness measure. Deduplicate exact code/date pairs; report support and CRC/non-CRC overlap in every H category before fitting.

Reserve is the parent’s score: `grip_max=max(46-0.0,47-0.0)`, one side if needed, and at least three of grip_max, albumin `30600-0.0`, creatinine `30700-0.0`, cystatin C `30720-0.0`. Transform within training data only: sex-stratified grip standardization, log albumin, negative-log creatinine/cystatin C; `R` is the mean of available standardized components. Preserve component count/missingness; complete-four, min-three, grip-only and laboratory-only are sensitivities. Covariates: age `21022-0.0`, sex `31-0.0`, BMI `21001-0.0`, smoking `20116-0.0`, assessment year, cancer class/subsite, and dated pre-`t0` Charlson count from `41270/41280`, excluding the incident cancer. `34-0.0` is a calendar audit.

For g in {CRC, nonCRC} and H category h, estimate
`A_g,h=P(Y=1|g,h,R=Q25)-P(Y=1|g,h,R=Q75)`,
with quartiles fixed in training. Primary estimand:
`D_contact=sum_h w_h(A_CRC,h-A_nonCRC,h)`,
where `w_h` is the locked eligible-case H distribution. Report each stratum, `D_contact`, continuous-lag effects, counts and participant-bootstrap 95% intervals. Positive means lower reserve is more associated with near-assessment recorded diagnosis for CRC than non-CRC after measured recordability standardization. This still is not population risk, causal effect, true diagnosis delay or contact-adjusted biology.

### Same-source negative control

Construct a separate observed-event sample from `41270/41280`: no observed pre-assessment C00–C97 record in either history, earliest valid post-`b_i` paired code/date not C00–C97, `0<L^{NC}<=1825`, valid reserve/covariates; `Y^{NC}=1` for <730 days. Estimate `A_NC=P(Y^{NC}=1|H,R=Q25)-P(Y^{NC}=1|H,R=Q75)`, standardized to its H distribution, and a unified class-by-reserve interaction across CRC, non-CRC and NC records. This is conditioned on a recorded non-cancer diagnosis like the primary is conditioned on recorded cancer; it never treats absent records as non-events. Report code-family support. Sparse/non-comparable NC data are inconclusive, not negative evidence.

### Ascertainment representation

For each primary case, parse the first post-`b_i` cancer pair in `41270/41280`, if present. Report availability, CRC/non-CRC class agreement, date difference, exact-date and +/-30-day concordance, and re-estimate `D_contact` using that source as anchor. This is a second representation, not an adjudicated gold standard or independent registry; instability is adverse.

## 4. Baseline, learned alternative and deliverable

The actual deliverable is newly fitted `D_contact`, `A_NC`, class-by-reserve interactions, H support/overlap, source concordance, locked uncertainty and interpretation outputs. No fit is claimed here.

Use one eid-hash split, seed 36, 70/15/15 train/validation/locked test, assigned before row construction and shared across primary/NC rows. Fit transformations, imputation, reserve quartiles, H weights, tuning and thresholds without locked-test inspection.

- B0: interpretable multinomial logistic regression for CRC-short, CRC-long, nonCRC-short, nonCRC-long with age spline, sex, BMI, smoking, year, Charlson, H category and subsite where defined.
- B1: B0 plus one-SD R, component count/missingness, reserve-by-class and reserve-by-H interactions; a separate same-form NC model estimates A_NC.
- B2: CPU gradient-boosted multinomial model on the same one-row-per-participant primary inputs and split, adding four reserve components, R, H count/category/indicator, baseline covariates and prespecified reserve-by-class/H interactions. Fixed grid: 200/400 trees, depth 2/3, learning rate .03/.05; validation log loss and multiclass Brier select one. Fit analogous NC model without cancer class/subsite.

B2 is retained because B1 compresses H to categories and reserve to a scalar; B2 can reveal stable component thresholds or H-by-class concentration. It is not selected for a small predictive gain. Relevance requires stable patterns across 365/730/1460-day checks and a change in CRC-versus-control interpretation. Report held-out calibration, Brier/log loss, secondary class AUC, `D_contact`, `A_NC`, interaction contrasts, component permutation importance and descriptive accumulated-local-effect tables. Use >=500 participant-bootstrap resamples.

Future solver estimate: CPU, 2–4 cores, 8–16 GiB, approximately 20–40 minutes after selected-column reads; unverified. GPU is unnecessary for tabular fits. A readiness job must verify source value support, H overlap and event support.

## 5. Falsification and interpretation

Run once under the frozen specification and retain adverse results.

1. H-stratified `A_g,h`: disappearance, reversal or lack of overlap after H standardization supports selection/recordability.
2. Same-source NC: an `A_NC` similar to CRC and unified interaction supports generic documentation timing; sparse NC is inconclusive.
3. Alternate `41270/41280` anchor: material class/date disagreement or changed `D_contact` is adverse.
4. Occult timing: repeat 365 and 1460 days and continuous lag. Short-window-only signal supports diagnostic proximity/occult disease, not durable reserve.
5. CRC specificity: compare other digestive and non-digestive cancers when supported; similar controls weaken specificity.
6. Age/comorbidity/measurement: age-only, age-plus-Charlson, flexible-age, complete-four, min-three, grip-only and lab-only fits; attenuation is confounding/selection/measurement evidence, not mechanism.
7. Coding/leakage: retain all slot audits; permute reserve within sex and labels once with fixed seeds. Any permutation signal invalidates the fit.
8. Follow-up: state `tau_source` failed; do not fit mortality, use no-record as no-event, or use `20191-0.0` as a cutoff.

**Supportive:** clinically material positive `D_contact` with interval excluding zero; consistent CRC-specific direction in adequately supported H strata and 365/730/1460 checks; no comparable NC/non-CRC contrast; stable alternate anchor; calibrated B2 may reveal stable component/H structure. This supports only documented-case CRC timing association conditional on measured proxies.

**Adverse:** H adjustment removes/reverses the contrast; CRC, non-CRC and NC slopes are similar; coding/source unstable; shortest-window-only; one-component-driven; or erased by age/comorbidity/missingness. This supports generic recordability, selection, occult timing or measurement and abandons durable CRC-reserve interpretation.

**Inconclusive:** sparse events, poor H overlap, wide intervals, unstable pairing/concordance, poor calibration or readiness failure. Not a null. Continuation requires outcome-complete linkage, clinical adjudication, stage/treatment/symptom/encounter data or an independent cohort.

Computationally checkable: hashes, schemas, joins, paired parsing, case flow, H, lag, models, calibration, intervals and conclusion/output linkage. Clinical adjudication/another study is required for true encounters, ascertainment completeness, symptoms, diagnosis dates, stage, treatment, recurrence, cause of death, causality and generalizability.

## 6. Alternatives and revisit conditions

The parent’s five-year competing-risk mortality analysis remains deferred because no `tau_source` establishes complete event ascertainment; shortening its horizon does not repair it. Full-population incidence remains deferred because no-record would be silently treated as no cancer. The original unstratified case-only contrast is descriptive only.

An exact encounter model is unavailable because no encounter/contact table or dates exist; H is the narrowest available dated-code proxy and must not be renamed contact. A full disease-history sequence model is deferred because it cannot solve missing encounter provenance or ascertainment and the substantive H-by-class uncertainty is directly testable by B2. Revisit it only if outcome-complete dated history is admitted and B2 reveals reproducible temporal structure. Return to mortality/incidence only with documented `tau_source`, linkage rules, outcome dates and cause adjudication; a clinical reserve interpretation additionally needs stage, treatment, symptoms/referral and independent validation.

## 7. References/evidence

Exactly three distinct works are inspected, all abstract-only. Structured receipts: `key-references.json`. No inaccessible full text or supplementary methods are claimed.

# UKB diagnosis-anchored CRC timing: temporal record-history state transition child

Status: proposed, not fitted. Child of candidate-a403c72d4e353a7f9c5b0237. This is a complementary formulation of the documented-record question; it does not restore the failed mortality/incidence endpoint, convert diagnosis dates into encounter dates, or claim a fitted result.

## 1. Scientific opening and claim boundary

The inherited proposal makes the strongest available claim deliberately narrow: among people with a valid 2006–2010 assessment and a subsequently observed paired cancer record, lower assessment-time reserve may be associated with a shorter lag to that recorded diagnosis, with a CRC-versus-other-cancer contrast. Its dated non-cancer history count H is a useful control, but H compresses a temporally ordered record history into one scalar. A person with one recent code and a person with ten remote codes can have similar or different H categories despite very different observable record histories.

The unresolved question is whether the reserve-by-lag contrast is specific to CRC timing after representing the *temporal state of recorded diagnosis history*, or whether it is a general transition-to-documentation pattern. This matters clinically because a positive CRC-specific temporal contrast could justify an encounter-complete study of prediagnostic vulnerability and diagnostic proximity; a contrast that follows generic history recency/repetition would warn against presenting reserve as a CRC biological detector or screening signal.

Evidence already supports, but does not prove, three boundaries. [K1] reports a post-diagnosis mixed-oncology frailty-survival association. [K2] makes occult disease a plausible rival by reporting physiological change years before some cancer diagnoses. [K3] shows that stage, treatment and complete register follow-up can materially bound CRC interpretation, but those fields are not in this UKB binding. None establishes a CRC-specific prediagnostic reserve-to-recorded-lag mechanism.

The leading explanation is occult CRC or diagnostic proximity: lower reserve may be closer to an underlying CRC process, so its association should concentrate in CRC and the shortest lag window. The consequential rival is recordability: recent/recurrent documented diagnoses mark a participant whose conditions are more likely to generate coding opportunities, so reserve may associate with short lags for CRC, other cancer and non-cancer diagnoses alike. Age, comorbidity, symptoms, referral, screening and coding differences can produce either pattern. This experiment can separate observable timing patterns, not prove mechanism, healthcare contact, true disease onset or causality.

Hypothesis: conditional on an observed post-assessment paired diagnosis-history event, the reserve contrast in near-assessment lag is larger for first recorded CRC than for first recorded non-cancer diagnoses after standardizing to the same pre-assessment temporal history states; the CRC excess is concentrated in the near window and is not explained by the history-state gradient. If the contrast is equal across classes or disappears after state representation, generic recordability is the better-supported explanation.

The baseline loses information in two ways: it treats recency and repetition as interchangeable within H categories, and it asks the CRC/non-CRC contrast using different event representations. Before any fit, report:

1. exact source paths, hashes, table IDs, archive members, namespace and selected columns;
2. paired-slot parseability, malformed code/date, duplicate code/date, pre-cancer exclusion and earliest-event tie counts;
3. support for every (G	imes S	imes) near/late cell and CRC/NC overlap in each state;
4. reserve component availability and missingness by class/state;
5. agreement of the same-source CRC class/date with the earliest valid paired `40005/40006` record when available, exact-date and +/-30-day concordance;
6. no use of `20191-0.0` as a censoring or completeness cutoff.

Primary state support is adequate only if every required CRC and NC state/window cell has at least 30 participants in the analysis population and every fitted train/validation/locked cell is nonempty. If a state fails this gate, do not merge states after inspection; report the design as inconclusive. A predeclared fallback may be run once: combine S=2 and S=3 as “recent,” retaining S=0 and S=1, only if that combined cell and all class/window cells pass the same support rule. Otherwise stop before fitting.

Falsification and boundary checks are fixed in advance:

- **Temporal specificity:** repeat near cutoffs at 365 and 730 days and late cutoffs at 1460 days. A CRC contrast confined to the shortest window supports diagnostic proximity/occult timing, not durable reserve.
- **Generic recordability:** compare (A_{mathrm{CRC},s}), (A_{mathrm{other cancer},s}) and (A_{mathrm{NC},s}) within state. Similar slopes or a state gradient shared across classes support documentation selection.
- **State attenuation:** compare B0 H-category and B1 temporal-state estimates. Strong attenuation or reversal after recency/repetition representation is adverse to a scalar-reserve CRC interpretation; it does not prove an encounter mechanism.
- **Source concordance:** material CRC class/date disagreement or a materially changed contrast when `40005/40006` is used as a sensitivity anchor is adverse. Concordance is not adjudication or independent validation.
- **Confounding/measurement:** age-only, age-plus-Charlson, complete-four, minimum-three, grip-only and laboratory-only reserve fits; attenuation identifies confounding, selection or measurement dependence, not mechanism.
- **Coding:** report all tie, unpaired, malformed and non-ICD-normalizable slots; any reserve signal after one fixed within-state label permutation invalidates the corresponding computation.
- **Selection:** compare eligible event-conditioned participants with all dated assessment participants on available age, sex, BMI, smoking, year and component availability. No inverse-probability analysis can repair missing-not-at-random event observation without an outcome-complete sampling model.

Supportive results require passed readiness, adequate CRC/NC overlap, a positive (D_{mathrm{temp}}) with a 95% interval excluding zero, a larger and near-window-concentrated CRC contrast than NC in supported states, no comparable other-cancer/NC pattern, stable source concordance, and no permutation signal. This supports only a robust association among observed diagnosis-history transitions.

Adverse results are state-adjusted attenuation/reversal, similar CRC/other-cancer/NC contrasts, source instability, a signal only in the shortest window, one reserve component or missingness rule driving the result, or permutation leakage. These support generic recordability, occult timing, coding or selection and should abandon or narrow a durable CRC-reserve interpretation.

Inconclusive results are failed state overlap, sparse ties or events, wide intervals, unstable source pairing, failed calibration, failed bootstrap, or any provenance/readiness gate failure. An imprecise null is not refutation. Continuation would require encounter-level dates, symptom/referral/screening information, ascertainment-complete linkage, stage, treatment, clinical diagnosis-date adjudication or an independent cohort.

The follow-up source remains audit-only: it has `eid` and `20191-0.0), with no verified common `tau_source) or completeness cutoff. The inherited five-year mortality analysis remains failed/deferred. Shortening the window to 1825 days does not repair that missing provenance because this experiment is conditioned on an observed event and does not claim risk in the full cohort.

A full dated disease-history sequence model is deferred: the available arrays are sparse paired diagnosis fields without encounter provenance, symptom context or a verified complete observation process. Sequence learning could recover ordering, but it cannot distinguish an undocumented encounter from no encounter and would add model complexity without resolving the central uncertainty. Revisit it only if encounter-level dated data are admitted or if B1 demonstrates reproducible temporal structure that a longer validated history can test. Multi-omics and mechanistic biology are also deferred because no validated molecular CRC endpoint, stage, histology, treatment or independent clinical outcome is bound to this question.

Computationally checkable: source hashes and schemas, namespace-safe joins, paired parsing, state construction, event-class/lag targets, support gates, model fitting, locked predictions, calibration, bootstrap intervals and whether conclusions match outputs. Clinical adjudication or another study is required for true encounters, completeness, symptoms, referral, screening, diagnosis onset, stage, treatment, mechanism, causality and generalizability.

# Evolution repair: narrow the CRC timing estimand to paired observed records

Status: proposed, not fitted. Parent: candidate-a403c72d4e353a7f9c5b0237. This is a substantive child repair motivated by an exact-schema audit and an unsuccessful bounded support probe. It preserves the failed \`tau_source\` boundary, the \`ukb672073\` namespace, the five exact Parquet bindings, and the inherited three-work abstract-only evidence receipts.

## Decision in this episode

The 41270/41280 construct is usable as a dated diagnosis-history variable, but it is not validated as healthcare contact, encounter frequency, ascertainment completeness, or recordability truth. The catalog proves that it has 259 paired code/date slots; it does not prove that the slots are complete or that the number of dated codes measures contact. The attempted bounded aggregate support pass exceeded the 120-second shell limit before emitting results, so no H-category overlap or event counts are treated as observed.

Therefore I do not retain the parent’s H-standardized contrast as the primary claim. The child narrows the estimand to the directly observable, diagnosis-anchored comparison and uses 41270/41280 as a prespecified second representation of the same recorded diagnosis. H remains a secondary descriptive/gated diagnostic. If its CRC/non-CRC cells fail overlap, the H analysis stops as inconclusive; it cannot rescue or invalidate the primary observed-record comparison.

## 1. Scientific opening, supported claim, unresolved claim

The inherited inspected evidence supports three bounded points. [K1] reports an association between a patient-reported/comorbidity frailty construct and survival in a mixed oncology setting; it is post-diagnosis and does not establish a pre-assessment CRC timing effect. [K2] reports physiological change in the years before some cancer diagnoses, making occult disease or diagnostic proximity a serious rival to a reserve interpretation. [K3] is a Swedish national-register colorectal-cancer study whose complete registry, stage/treatment and follow-up infrastructure are not present in this UKB binding. All three are inherited abstract-only inspections; no inaccessible full text or supplement is claimed.

The strongest claim supported by the parent is only descriptive: among people with a subsequently recorded cancer, assessment-time reserve may be associated with the lag to that recorded diagnosis, possibly differently for CRC and non-CRC. It is not incidence, a true diagnosis date, screening performance, encounter frequency, stage, treatment tolerance, mortality, causality or mechanism.

The unresolved question is narrower and falsifiable:

> Among UKB participants assessed from 2006 through 2010 who have an observed paired cancer record within five years, is lower assessment-time measured reserve associated with a higher probability of a CRC diagnosis being recorded within 730 days rather than 730–1825 days, and does that CRC-versus-non-CRC timing contrast replicate when the first valid post-assessment 41270/41280 record is used as the diagnosis representation?

A CRC-specific and source-replicated contrast would support a robust association with the timing of recorded CRC among recorded cases. A comparable non-CRC contrast, source disagreement, or a signal confined to <730 days would support recordability/selection, coding instability, or occult diagnostic proximity rather than a durable reserve interpretation. No possible result identifies the mechanism.

Clinical advance: the result determines whether a pre-assessment reserve signal merits an outcome-complete validation study or should be abandoned as an ascertainment-sensitive artifact. It does not change screening or treatment.

## 2. Exact source audit and immutable boundaries

## 4. Estimands and recordability diagnostic

For source \(s\in\{40005,412\}\), cancer group \(g\in\{CRC,nonCRC\}\), and reserve value \(r\), estimate
\[
 A^s_g=P(Y^s=1\mid g,R=Q25)-P(Y^s=1\mid g,R=Q75).

The primary observable estimand is
\[

\]
The replication estimand is \(D_{412}=A^{412}_{CRC}-A^{412}_{nonCRC}\), reported with its eligible-case count and source-availability selection. Positive values mean lower reserve is more associated with an earlier *recorded* CRC diagnosis than an earlier recorded nonCRC diagnosis. They do not mean earlier biological diagnosis, healthcare contact, incidence or causation.

Retain the parent’s H definition only as a secondary diagnostic: from same-slot 41270/41280 pairs with nonempty code and parseable date in \([1900\text{-}01\text{-}01,b_i)\), deduplicate exact code/date pairs, exclude C00–C97, and define H categories 0, 1, 2–4, >=5. Report H support and CRC/nonCRC overlap before any H-stratified model. H is a dated diagnosis-history count, not contact, encounter frequency, completeness, symptom burden or referral.

The H diagnostic has a hard admissibility rule: every primary H stratum used in a contrast must have both cancer groups and prespecified minimum support documented in the readiness output; otherwise no H-adjusted estimate is interpreted. A failed or timed-out support scan is not evidence of overlap. If admissible, report H-stratified \(A_g\) and a locked H-distribution standardization as a sensitivity only. If H adjustment materially changes D40005 or if H patterns are similar across CRC/nonCRC, the result supports recordability/selection concerns and narrows the interpretation to the observable diagnosis-lag association.

## 5. Baseline, learned alternative and actual deliverable

The actual deliverable is newly fitted, output-linked \(D_{40005}\), \(D_{412}\), source availability/concordance, H support diagnostics, window sensitivities, calibrated predictions and participant-bootstrap uncertainty. No fitted result is claimed in this draft.

A small predictive gain alone does not justify the alternative. Use >=500 participant-bootstrap resamples for the primary contrasts and report the locked-test uncertainty.

GPU is not required for these tabular fits. The hardware audit identifies A100 capacity but ordinary shells have no allocation; no GPU was requested because device choice does not affect this bounded tabular design. A future sequence model is deferred because the question is resolved first by paired observable timing and the verified data do not establish complete dated trajectories or encounter provenance.

## 6. Falsification and interpretation

Run once under the frozen specification; retain all adverse results.

1. **Source replication:** materially different direction, class assignment or date difference between 40005/40006 and 41270/41280 is adverse to a stable record-timing interpretation. Exact and ±30-day concordance are descriptive representation checks, not adjudication.
2. **Control behavior:** if H is admissible and H-stratified reserve slopes are similar for CRC and nonCRC, or the contrast disappears after H sensitivity standardization, support generic recordability/selection. If H support fails, report inconclusive and do not call the absence of adjustment evidence.
3. **Window behavior:** a contrast only in <365 or <730 days supports diagnostic proximity/occult disease; a directionally stable effect through 1460 days is more consistent with a durable observed-case timing regularity but still not mechanism.
4. **Specificity:** compare other digestive and non-digestive cancer groups only when their paired-code support is adequate and frozen before fitting. Similar patterns weaken CRC specificity.
5. **Confounding and measurement:** age-only, age-plus-Charlson, flexible-age, complete-four, minimum-three, grip-only and laboratory-only sensitivities. Attenuation is evidence of confounding, selection or measurement dependence, not proof of mechanism.
6. **Coding/leakage:** report all malformed/unpaired/duplicate/discordant slots; perform one fixed-seed reserve permutation within sex and label permutation. Held-out signal under permutation invalidates the computation.
7. **Follow-up boundary:** retain \`tau_source\` failed. Do not fit mortality, use \`20191-0.0\` as a cutoff, or treat no cancer record as cancer-free/no event.

Supportive results require adequate counts and overlap, positive D40005 with an interval excluding zero, a directionally compatible D412 in a prespecified eligible representation, no comparable nonCRC/control pattern, no material coding instability, and no permutation leakage. This supports only a robust association with timing of recorded CRC diagnoses among recorded cases.

Adverse results are H attenuation, comparable CRC/nonCRC slopes, source instability, shortest-window-only behavior, one-component dependence, or disappearance after age/comorbidity/missingness. These support recordability, selection, occult timing or measurement and abandon a durable reserve interpretation.

Inconclusive results are sparse or non-overlapping H cells, too few CRC/nonCRC cases, wide intervals, failed pair parsing, low source concordance, poor calibration, or readiness failure. An imprecise null is not refutation. Continuing would require an outcome-complete linkage source, documented encounter/contact dates, clinical review of diagnosis timing, stage/treatment/symptom/referral data or an independent cohort.

Computationally checkable: source hashes, schemas, namespace-safe joins, paired parsing, cohort flow, lag categories, H audit, source concordance, fitted objects, calibration, bootstrap intervals and whether conclusions match outputs. Clinical adjudication or another study is required for true diagnosis dates, ascertainment completeness, encounters, symptoms, referral, stage, treatment, recurrence, mortality, mechanism, causality and generalizability.

## 7. Alternatives and revisit conditions

The parent’s five-year competing-risk mortality branch remains deferred because no common \`tau_source\` establishes complete event ascertainment. Shortening the horizon cannot repair that missing dependency. Full-population incidence remains deferred because the available data do not authorize treating absence of a record as absence of cancer.

An exact encounter model is unavailable: no encounter/contact table or encounter dates were found in the exact configured schemas. H is not renamed to contact. A full dated disease-history sequence model is deferred because it cannot resolve missing encounter provenance or ascertainment; revisit only if outcome-complete dated histories are admitted and the source-replication analysis reveals reproducible temporal structure not captured by B1.

The alternative not chosen is the parent’s H-standardized primary estimand. Evidence for revisiting it would be an independently completed support audit showing prespecified CRC/nonCRC H overlap and a stable, interpretable contrast across source representations. Evidence against revisiting is sparse/non-overlapping H support or similar H patterns in CRC/nonCRC. The alternative not chosen is mortality/incidence; revisit only with documented linkage completeness, outcome dates and clinical adjudication.
